description: This file defines the class 'Article' within the Opencart CMS module, implementing methods to interact with article data in the database, including retrieval, update, comment management, and rating features.

classes.name: Article
classes.description: Provides methods for CRUD operations on articles, comments, and ratings within the CMS, encapsulating database interactions and business logic.

methods.name: getArticle
methods.description: Retrieves a specific article record by its ID, including description and store associations.

methods.name: getArticles
methods.description: Retrieves a list of articles based on optional filters, supports search, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: editRating
methods.description: Updates the rating value for a specific article.

methods.name: getTotalArticles
methods.description: Returns the total count of articles matching optional filters.

methods.name: getLayoutId
methods.description: Fetches the layout ID associated with a specific article.

methods.name: addComment
methods.description: Adds a new comment to an article, returns the new comment ID.

methods.name: editCommentRating
methods.description: Updates the rating for a specific article comment.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves a specific comment by its ID.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Retrieves comments for an article with optional filters like parent ID, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalComments
methods.description: Retrieves the total count of comments for an article with optional filters.

methods.name: addRating
methods.description: Creates a new rating record for an article comment.

methods.name: deleteRating
methods.description: Removes a rating record for an article comment.

methods.name: getRatings
methods.description: Retrieves rating statistics for an article or specific comment.
